n09.prompt:
Create ONE landscape 2:1 sheet for a dialogue portrait pair: two equally sized SQUARE panels in one row, no drawn separator. One waist-free chest-up bust of exactly the same person per panel. The attached card is the canonical person, costume and color reference: its large cutout is the master and small figure is the actual game sprite. Redraw that exact character at the requested camera angle; use the same head, age, hair, clothes, skin and color palette in both panels. Register crown, chin, eyes and shoulders consistently in the two panels. Head (crown to chin) fills roughly half of each square height, about 54%; show the chest ending above the bottom. Distinct clear large dark expressive eyes with a small eye light, readable eyebrows, and readable mouth, deliberately bold facial shapes. All hair tips and outer shoulders fully within each square. Keep uniform blank margin 7-9% above and below and at least 8% at both side edges. Compact shoulders or crop accessories to the chest silhouette if necessary. Use a deliberately broad angled cut across the jacket at the bottom of each bust, no glow or fade. Match the reference's graphic planar low-color color-block rendering: bold flat lineless angular color regions with 2 skin tones and 2-3 shades per material, larger readable shapes and controlled top-left lighting. No blended airbrush, gradients, cast shadows, outlines, photographic texture, reference text or captions, decorative borders, poster composition, watermark, scene, or pixel grid. Pure flat saturated #FF00FF RGB(255,0,255) background behind both separate portraits and margins. Cyan only on reference costume gear and only as appropriate, no cyan rim on hair or skin. Return a single still image.
N-09 looks slightly toward screen-right in both cells, a shallow three-quarter view with the nose and eyes aiming right. A slim adult with exposed face, sharply layered windswept white spikes pointing back and up with light blue-gray shadow planes, a conspicuous heavy black upper lash line around a dark teal eye, dark almost-black fitted raised-collar shirt, ripped sleeves and the segmented teal arm band on the visible shoulder as in the reference. Keep the look serious, tired and youthful without changing identity. Left square: emotionally neutral, closed mouth, level brow and steady eyes. Right square: visibly clenched teeth shown as one short off-white shape, lowered strongly angled eyebrows and tense cheek, unwavering determination, with the same head tilt and shoulders.
